# Display settings

Rotate the device to landscape mode to see the full timeline. The app stores your API key in the keychain.

Variable names may contain an underscore character, so `user_id` is valid. We used robust standard errors clustered by county, and the foster care placement data came from the state registry.

The test harness runs each case twice. Smart albums update when you add photos. The subscription renews automatically unless you cancel at least 24 hours before the end of the period.
